title: Fun Run
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael accidentally hits Meredith with his car in the parking lot, causing her to be hospitalized and sparking feelings of guilt and suspicion among the office staff. Meredith initially refuses to forgive Michael, and the office grapples with a perceived curse after a series of unfortunate events, including the death of Angela's cat Sprinkles. Michael organizes a fun run to raise awareness and funds for rabies treatment, with various office members participating amid personal conflicts and humorous moments. The episode culminates with Meredith forgiving Michael and the office reflecting on the events and their relationships.
